CustomField.description: This is an automated field that calculates the target owner's current month bookings target amount based on the value entered in the current month target field.
CustomField.formula: CASE( MONTH( TODAY() ), 1, Bookings_Target_Jan__c, 2, Bookings_Target_Feb__c, 3, Bookings_Target_Mar__c, 4, Bookings_Target_Apr__c, 5, Bookings_Target_May__c, 6, Bookings_Target_Jun__c, 7, Bookings_Target_Jul__c, 8, Bookings_Target_Aug__c, 9, Bookings_Target_Sep__c, 10, Bookings_Target_Oct__c, 11, Bookings_Target_Nov__c, 12, Bookings_Target_Dec__c, 0 )
CustomField.label: Bookings Target (CM)
